# 2 Baruch Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1:1** And-it-came-to-pass in-the-twenty-and-fifth year-of-Jeconiah king-of-Judah, that the-word-of-the-LORD came to-Baruch son-of-Neriah, saying:

**1:2** "Have-you-seen all that this-people is-doing to-me, [namely] the-evils which the-two-tribes-that-remained have-committed? greater [are they] than the-ten-tribes that-were-carried-away captive.

**1:3** For the-former-tribes were-led-away by-their-kings, but-these-two have-themselves-been-the-cause of-their-own-captivity, in-that they-constrained their-king to-sin.

**1:4** Behold, therefore I-am-bringing evil upon-this-city and upon-its-inhabitants, and it-shall-be-removed from-before my-face for-a-season.

**1:5** And I-will-scatter this-people among the-nations that-they-may-do-good to-the-nations, and my-people shall-be-chastened thereby. And [in]-the-time-of-their-testing they-shall-groan."

---

*EMET notes: Hyphenated compounds preserve Syriac construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar. The 25th year of Jeconiah is the textual datum. "Two tribes" = Judah and Benjamin.*
